# yd-skillset

Dual-target Agent Skills repo — the same `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` set installs into Claude Code and Codex CLI. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are kept **byte-identical** (Codex reads the former, Claude the latter); the pre-commit hook rejects any commit where they differ. Both files, and every harness manifest, are generated from `plugin.source.json` + skill frontmatter by `scripts/generate.py`. See [README.md](README.md) for install and authoring.

Plugin name: `yd-skillset`. Marketplace name: `yd-skillset`.

## Skills shipped

<!-- SKILLS:START (generated by scripts/generate.py — do not edit) -->

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `algo-craft` | In-place algorithmic work on a narrow target — add a new algorithm, improve an existing one, refactor to the same intent, or evaluate that it should be left alone, scoped to a function, class, or single file. |
| `algo-rewrite` | Whole-codebase greenfield algorithmic rewrite pipeline for any language — inventory every algorithm, data flow, and feature; extract per-component contract cards that split observable behavior into PINNED / FLEXIBLE / SUSPECT under the intent-oracle rule (v1 witnesses the contract's spirit, never the algorithm; bug-for-bug compatibility is refused); triage through correctness / SIMD / concurrency / library-first / hot-cold lenses; then run each component through a pipeline — ideate greenfield replacements under a no-compatibility rule, adversarially refute each component's ideas in an independent comparative refuter that nominates an adversarial benchmark shape per survivor, settle survivors by benchmark shootout under measured noise (interleaved repetitions with recorded spread, contended runs for concurrent code, zero-alloc hot paths, proportional speed-vs-simplicity adoption), build fresh-file v2 components red-first with class-map tests, contract-level differential tests against v1, and property tests, then verify each through the adversarial spine — risk-gated blind edge-hunter, race oracle plus interleaving-hunter on concurrent components, deterministic boundary enforcement at every trust boundary, and a hardening-oracle pass — prove in situ against macro baselines, and audit feature parity with a gap-hunter agent that can force full re-iteration. |
| `harden` | Iterative, low-noise hardening review that only fixes proven defects — boundary violations, concurrency bugs (data races/deadlocks), resource/lifetime errors (leaks, use-after-free, double-release, dangling references), and garbage/uninitialized data. |
| `mastermind` | Meta-skill that turns the expensive main-thread model into a pure decision-maker — every file read, search, build, edit, and web lookup is executed by cheaper-model subagents; the main thread is forbidden all direct IO and tools except agent dispatch, skill invocation, and the todo list. |
| `msvcpp-toolkit` | C++ language toolkit, MSVC/Windows-first — the language-specific half of the algo-rewrite, algo-craft, and harden skills. |
| `test-practice` | Language-agnostic testing rulebook — the testing half of algo-rewrite, algo-craft, and harden. |

<!-- SKILLS:END -->

## Editing

Source of truth is `plugin.source.json` (repo metadata) plus each `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` frontmatter. Edit `AGENTS.md` only (never `CLAUDE.md` — it is a generated byte-copy), then run `python scripts/generate.py` (or `--check` to verify freshness + byte-identity). Do not hand-edit the generated manifests or the table above.

## Updating the local Claude Code install

The plugin is installed at **local** scope (this repo), so `claude plugin update yd-skillset` alone fails — it looks at user scope. After committing changes:

```
claude plugin marketplace update yd-skillset
claude plugin update yd-skillset@yd-skillset --scope local
```

Then restart Claude Code to pick up the new version. The version shown comes from `plugin.source.json` — bump it before updating or the change is invisible in `claude plugin list`.

## scripts/generate.py

No need to read the script — this section is the contract.

- `python scripts/generate.py` — regenerates everything, prints each artifact with `(updated)` flags. Idempotent; run after any edit to `plugin.source.json`, a `SKILL.md` frontmatter, or `AGENTS.md`.
- `python scripts/generate.py --check` — writes nothing; exit 1 listing stale artifacts (the pre-commit gate), exit 0 if fresh.

Generated artifacts: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, the SKILLS table between `<!-- SKILLS:START -->`/`<!-- SKILLS:END -->` markers in `README.md`/`AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` itself (byte-copy of `AGENTS.md`).

Behavior/constraints:

- Skill frontmatter is parsed by a minimal single-line `key: value` parser — `name` and `description` are required and must each fit on one line (no multi-line/nested YAML).
- `name` in frontmatter must equal the skill's directory name, or the script exits with an error.
- The SKILLS table shows only the first sentence of each description (split on `". "`).
- Both modes fail (exit 1) if `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` differ on disk, or if a doc loses its SKILLS marker pair.
